description: Stable local API error codes. Codes are part of the contract: a code's meaning and HTTP status may not change without a contract major version. `retryable` means the same request may succeed later without changing the payload; it never authorizes a blind order retry (see ADR-0006).

codes.summary: No local API credential was supplied.
codes.userAction: Use the CLI token or open the local UI from the served origin.

codes.summary: The local API credential is invalid or expired.
codes.userAction: Restart the daemon to rotate the local token, then retry.

codes.summary: The CSRF token is missing or does not match the session.
codes.userAction: Reload the UI from the local origin and retry.

codes.summary: The request Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site does not match the served origin.
codes.userAction: Open the UI from 127.0.0.1 or localhost; do not proxy from another origin.

codes.summary: The Host header is not an allowed loopback host.
codes.userAction: Use 127.0.0.1:<port> or localhost:<port>.

codes.summary: The requested object or route does not exist.
codes.userAction: Check the identifier or route; list the collection to find the object.

codes.summary: The HTTP method is not valid for this route.
codes.userAction: Use the documented method; see the API contract.

codes.summary: The request conflicts with the current state.
codes.userAction: Refresh the object and retry with the current version.

codes.summary: One or more request fields failed validation.
codes.userAction: Fix the named fields and retry.

codes.summary: The payload does not satisfy its JSON Schema.
codes.userAction: Fix the payload shape; never coerce an invalid object.

codes.summary: The requested output format is not supported for this object.
codes.userAction: Use table, json, ndjson, csv, or lines as documented.

codes.summary: A state-changing request was sent without an Idempotency-Key.
codes.userAction: Generate a unique key for the logical action and retry.

codes.summary: The same idempotency key was used with a different request payload.
codes.userAction: Use a new key for a different action; retry the original payload with the original key.

codes.summary: The local API or an internal limiter is throttling the request.
codes.userAction: Wait for Retry-After and retry.

codes.summary: An unexpected internal error occurred.
codes.userAction: Retry once; if it persists, check the logs with the reference ID.

codes.summary: The route or capability is not implemented in this version.
codes.userAction: Check the milestone and the CLI help.

codes.summary: SQLite or the Parquet catalog is unavailable.
codes.userAction: Check disk, permissions, and `oft doctor`; retry after recovery.

codes.summary: Storage failed an integrity check.
codes.userAction: Stop trading; restore from a verified backup.

codes.summary: The configuration is missing, unreadable, or inconsistent.
codes.userAction: Run `oft doctor`; fix or restore config; do not silently reset.

codes.summary: The daemon is not running, so the mutating command cannot execute.
codes.userAction: Start it with `oft daemon start`; status/doctor still work offline.

codes.summary: The local clock differs from Binance server time beyond the allowed threshold.
codes.userAction: Sync the system clock; live ordering is blocked until it is within tolerance.

codes.summary: An upstream request timed out.
codes.userAction: Retry with backoff; check network.

codes.summary: An upstream service is unreachable or returned an invalid response.
codes.userAction: Retry with backoff; check the provider status.

codes.summary: Binance rejected the API key or signature.
codes.userAction: Re-enter/rotate the key in settings; verify futures permissions.

codes.summary: Binance returned 429 or 418; the request weight/order limit was exceeded.
codes.userAction: Stop retries, wait out the ban, and reduce concurrency.

codes.summary: The current IP is not allowed by the Binance key's IP allowlist.
codes.userAction: Add the machine's IP in Binance or remove the allowlist.

codes.summary: The TradFi perpetuals agreement has not been signed for this account.
codes.userAction: Sign `POST /fapi/v1/stock/contract` with the user's key, then retry.

codes.summary: The symbol is not in TRADING status.
codes.userAction: Remove or replace the symbol; refresh the registry.

codes.summary: A required data window has a gap.
codes.userAction: Run or wait for backfill; the report will be marked PARTIAL until resolved.

codes.summary: Data is older than its freshness budget.
codes.userAction: Refresh the feed; stale marks block risk-dependent execution.

codes.summary: Required data does not exist or cannot be fetched.
codes.userAction: Check coverage; some data (e.g. USD-M historical liquidations) has no source.

codes.summary: One or more required metrics could not be computed.
codes.userAction: Inspect quality reasons; retry after data recovery.

codes.summary: A downloaded archive file failed SHA256 verification.
codes.userAction: Re-download the file; never convert an unverified archive.

codes.summary: A backfill is already running.
codes.userAction: Wait for it to finish or inspect its progress.

codes.summary: The local data manifest is older than the archive source or a correction was published.
codes.userAction: Re-check the archive changelog and refresh affected files.

codes.summary: No LLM provider/key is configured for this role.
codes.userAction: Add a provider key in settings/onboarding.

codes.summary: The LLM provider rejected the API key.
codes.userAction: Replace or rotate the provider key.

codes.summary: No model is configured for this LLM role.
codes.userAction: Set the role model in settings; no default model is shipped.

codes.summary: The LLM provider cannot enforce the requested structured output schema.
codes.userAction: Use a provider or mode that supports structured output; the capability probe records the degradation.

codes.summary: The LLM call exceeded its timeout.
codes.userAction: Retry; the decision was not executed.

codes.summary: The LLM provider rate-limited the request.
codes.userAction: Wait/back off; reduce concurrency.

codes.summary: The model refused the request.
codes.userAction: Record the refusal; do not execute. Review the prompt or try another provider manually.

codes.summary: The model output failed schema or semantic validation after the repair attempt.
codes.userAction: No action was executed; inspect the failing fields and alert.

codes.summary: The model output was truncated (incomplete status).
codes.userAction: Reduce the payload or raise the output budget; do not execute the partial object.

codes.summary: A decision references a prompt version that no longer exists or has no pinned system version.
codes.userAction: Exact replay is disabled; restore the version or accept a non-reproducible replay.

codes.summary: A prompt template is missing a required variable or has invalid syntax.
codes.userAction: Fix the named variable/syntax; nothing was saved.

codes.summary: Live trading is not armed.
codes.userAction: Use Paper, or complete the 4-week gate and arm Live explicitly.

codes.summary: The required paper-trading duration has not been met (or was reset).
codes.userAction: Continue paper trading; the remaining duration is shown in settings.

codes.summary: The kill switch blocks new orders and LLM-driven execution.
codes.userAction: Do not trade. Inspect state, then resume with `RESUME` if safe.

codes.summary: The deterministic risk gate blocked the order.
codes.userAction: Inspect the binding cap; reduce size or adjust the plan. The LLM cannot override it.

codes.summary: A required risk input (mark, bracket, balance, position) is missing or stale.
codes.userAction: Refresh/reconcile; conservative defaults apply and may block.

codes.summary: An order with the same deterministic client_order_id already exists.
codes.userAction: Do not resubmit; inspect the existing order and reconcile.

codes.summary: Binance rejected the order (filters, margin, permissions, or state).
codes.userAction: Read the exchange error; fix the intent; do not blind-retry.

codes.summary: The order is not known locally or at the exchange.
codes.userAction: Reconcile before any resubmission.

codes.summary: The position does not exist or is closed.
codes.userAction: Refresh positions; use the journal for closed trades.

codes.summary: The requested action is invalid for the position state.
codes.userAction: Refresh state; use the allowed management actions.

codes.summary: Binance returned an unexpected error.
codes.userAction: Reconcile; retry only after the order state is known.

codes.summary: Local and exchange state disagree or are unknown.
codes.userAction: Run reconciliation; new orders are blocked until it succeeds.

codes.summary: A scan is already running.
codes.userAction: Inspect the running scan; wait for completion.

codes.summary: The Telegram bot token/chat is not configured.
codes.userAction: Configure Telegram in settings; alerts are disabled until then.

codes.summary: A Telegram message could not be delivered.
codes.userAction: Check the token/chat/allowlist; retries are recorded with receipts.
